newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore morning stocks weak, focus on Huan Hsin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore morning stocks weak, focus on Huan Hsin.

text.p: Singapore stocks mostly weakened at mid-morning on Wednesday as investors stayed sidelined fearing further falls, dealers said.
At 0220 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index shed 9.88 points to 2,004.90. Dealers said expectations were for the index to test 2,000 shortly amid a dearth of positive news.
"Most people believe the market is not at the bottom yet," said a dealer. He said one consolation was that the market was falling on thin volumes.
Total turnover was around 28.3 million shares with 79 gainers to 67 losers.
Debutante Huan Hsin, which makes telephone cords, rose to a high of US$0.53 before easing to US$0.475 against its initial offer price of US$0.42. Volume was over 7.8 million shares.
Food company, Cerebos Pacific slumped 10 percent or Singapore $0.80 (US$0.56) to S$7.20 after the company posted disappointing first half results and warned of a tougher second-half.
In contrast, consumer electronic products distributor Thakral Corp, shined and hit a high of US$1.05 after 1997 net profits rose 20 percent to S$68.6 million.
Creative led losers with a S$1.40 drop to S$22.80 while Jardine Matheson rose US$0.20 to US$7.45.
